model: PE-Core-B-16 image vector, PHONE-SIMULATED (448 px long side Lanczos + JPEG q80 4:2:0 round trip, then open_clip squash-224, fp16) - trained on r448q80 only
trained_on: Wikimedia Commons iPhone photos, EXIF front/back label, N=17594, pos=3028
geo_design: sqrt(area_frac), centre_off, centre_y, log1p(n_faces), second_ratio, has_face
score: logit = dot(w_folded, v) + b_folded on the stored L2-normalized vector; selfie if logit >= threshold
calibration_note: thresholds below are Commons out-of-fold numbers; the phone keeps its per-library calibration on its own tagged photos (PhotoIndex.selfieThreshold)

geo_rule.feature: largest face area / frame area (SCRFD box)
